name: API request
description: An outgoing request. SPEC-MANIFEST.md §5.3. Without body, the last successful output is sent in an envelope {runId, templateId, payload}. A loop may end here. This is a complete loop, not an unfinished one. SPEC does not enumerate response fields.

body.notes: JSON string or text. templated, deeply.

response.notes: SPEC-MANIFEST.md §5.3 does not list output fields. The step performs the request; when it is last, the loop is complete.
